The formal gate takes exactly one formal_spec per submission, so the N=32 proof needs its own submission or a parameter override. The RTL uses a synchronous active-low reset as the spec requires (not lowRISC's asynchronous default). It has no latches by construction: every combinational block assigns its defaults first, and every case has a default. The testbench drives inputs on the falling edge and samples 1 time unit after an edge to avoid races.
